final: WITH groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, 1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM groups) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - average_share AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
